packs.name: DAI Fundamentals — Survival
packs.summary: Official Survival example pack demonstrating menus, perception, objectives, harvesting, navigation, and autonomous behavior. Installs to DAI's global datapack library.

packs.name: DAI Comic Effects
packs.summary: Official combo pack: installs its reaction datapack into DAI's global datapack library and its companion visual resource pack client-wide.

packs.name: DAI Damage Indicators
packs.summary: Standalone DAI combat-feedback addon that displays large floating outgoing damage numbers above damaged living entities. No resource pack required.

packs.name: DAI Survival Interface
packs.summary: Standalone DAI RPG target HUD showing target name, current/max health, health progress, and approximate range while aiming at a living entity. No resource pack required.
